section: المنصور بن أبي عامر ونهاية الخلافة
quote: وبعد وفاته سنة 1002 م دخلت قرطبة بعد سنوات فتنة طويلة
fix: وبعد وفاته سنة 1002 م بسنوات قليلة دخلت قرطبة في فتنة طويلة
reason: Merge left an ungrammatical phrase ('entered after years a long fitna'). Also the fitna began in 1009, after his son Abd al-Malik's rule (1002-1008), not right at his death. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fitna_of_al-Andalus
Comma splice from merge joins two unrelated ideas (annexing Syria / non-hereditary rule); split into a new sentence.
Section opens with a pronoun ('his son') whose antecedent is not in this section after the merge. Karakorum walls 1235 is correct. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karakorum
